info.value: hAniH = utsargaH iti bAlamanoramA . tyAgaH iti kzIrasvAmI .

examples: 'yajasva dehi dIkzasva tapastapyasva santyaja' (rA॰2.108.16). santyaja=pravraja. samSabdastyAgasya paripUrRatAmAha, dattasyApratyApattim.
'yadidaM kzudraM sarIsfpaM grIzmahemantAByAM nityaktaM Bavati' (Sa0 brA0 1.5.3.11). nityaktamapasAritamapaseDitamapatrastam.
'imA ozaDayo grIzmahemantAByAM nityaktA Bavanti' (Sa0 brA0 1.5.3.12). tyaktAH satyaH kzIRA BavantItyarTaH.
'prArabDamuttamaguRA na parityajanti' (Bartf0, mudrA0 2.17). na parityajanti na vijahati na viramayanti.
'yA patyA vA parityaktA' (manu0 9.175). parityaktA nirAkftA pratyAdizwA.
'yo DruvARi parityajya aDruvARi nizevate' (hitopa0). parityajya parihftya, upekzya.
